title: User Registration with Valid Data
description: Verify that a new user can register successfully with valid email and password, receiving confirmation email.

steps.description: Navigate to the Signup page
Input a valid email address and a strong password
Submit the registration form
Confirm registration success and confirmation email sent

title: User Login with Correct Credentials
description: Check that an existing user can login successfully with valid email and password.

steps.description: Navigate to the Login page
Enter registered email and correct password
Click the login button
User is logged in and redirected to Dashboard

title: User Login with Invalid Credentials
description: Ensure login fails and proper error message is shown when using incorrect email or password.

steps.description: Navigate to the Login page
Input unregistered email or incorrect password
Click the login button
Show error message and do not allow login

title: Dashboard Displays Real-Time Flight Statistics
description: Verify dashboard shows real-time updated flight statistics, career summaries, goals, and achievements corresponding to the logged in user.

steps.description: Login to the application
Dashboard loads and displays personalized greeting
Verify statistics, goals, and achievements are correctly displayed and update in real-time on data change

title: Adding a New Flight Log with Valid Data
description: Verify that users can add a flight log with all required valid fields and that data validation prevents invalid entries.

steps.description: Navigate to Flight Management page
Click 'Add Flight Log'
Input valid airports, aircraft details, flight duration and route
Submit the flight log
Flight log saves successfully and appears in flight list

title: Flight Log Validation Rejects Invalid Airport Codes
description: Ensure that adding or editing a flight log with invalid airport codes triggers appropriate validation errors.

steps.description: Navigate to Flight Management page
Attempt to add a flight log with invalid departure or arrival airport codes
Submit the flight log
Form shows validation error for invalid airport codes and prevents submission

title: Financial Management Records Revenue and Expense Entries
description: Check that users can add, edit, and categorize revenues and expenses correctly and generate accurate financial reports.

steps.description: Navigate to Financial Management page
Add new revenue entry with valid details and assign to correct category
Add new expense entry with valid details and assign to correct category
Generate financial report
Entries appear correctly in the report with accurate calculations

title: Financial Entry Validation for Mandatory Fields
description: Ensure financial entries cannot be saved without required fields such as amount and category, displaying appropriate error messages.

steps.description: Navigate to Financial Management page
Attempt to save a revenue or expense entry without filling mandatory fields
Try submitting the form
Validation errors are shown and submission is blocked

title: Add and Manage Aircraft Maintenance Records
description: Verify users can add maintenance events, assign mechanics, schedule next services, and that costs are recorded correctly.

steps.description: Navigate to Maintenance Tracking page
Add a new maintenance record with valid date, mechanic, aircraft and cost details
Schedule upcoming maintenance
Maintenance record appears in the system with correct details and scheduling

title: Maintenance Record Validation for Scheduling and Cost
description: Ensure maintenance records cannot be saved with invalid or missing schedule or cost information.

steps.description: Attempt to add maintenance record without scheduling date or with negative cost
Submit the maintenance form
Form shows validation errors and rejects submission

title: Career Progression Displays Rating and Milestone Tracking
description: Validate that the Career Progression module correctly shows pilot ratings, milestone progress, and updates with user data.

steps.description: Navigate to Career Progression dashboard
User’s current rating and milestone progress are correctly displayed
Trigger update by adding a qualifying flight log or achievement
Career ratings and milestones update accordingly

title: Real-Time Flight Tracking and Map Updates
description: Verify real-time flight tracking feature shows accurate geospatial data and updates live flight routes on the map.

steps.description: Start a flight session or simulate active flight data
Navigate to Real-Time Tracking or Flight Maps pages
Map displays flight route and updates position in real-time

title: Multilanguage UI Text Rendering
description: Ensure switching languages updates all visible UI text correctly without layout or truncation issues.

steps.description: Navigate to Settings page
Change application language to supported languages one at a time
All UI text on all pages is updated accordingly and layout remains intact

title: Theme Customization Applies Correctly
description: Verify that selecting different UI themes in settings immediately changes the application theme and persists on refresh.

steps.description: Navigate to Settings page
Change theme using theme toggle switch
Theme updates visually throughout the app immediately
Reload application
Selected theme persists after reload

title: Automatic Flight Log Entry from Microsoft Flight Simulator
description: Test that flights launched on Microsoft Flight Simulator 2024 are detected and logged automatically with accurate telemetry data.

steps.description: Launch a flight within Microsoft Flight Simulator 2024
Observe integration component capturing flight data
Flight Log Opus automatically creates and saves the flight log with correct telemetry

title: Backend WebSocket Real-Time Data Update
description: Ensure that backend WebSocket service pushes real-time updates and connected clients update UI accordingly.

steps.description: Connect to the application from multiple clients
Make a data change such as adding a new flight log or financial entry in one client
Other connected clients receive real-time update and UI reflects changes instantly

title: Data Synchronization and Cloud Backup
description: Verify that all user data actions synchronize correctly with the cloud backend and backups can be triggered and restored.

steps.description: Perform a series of data operations (e.g. add flight, update financial data)
Trigger backup operation in Settings
Backup completes with confirmation and data can be restored to previous state

title: Accessibility and Responsiveness Across Devices
description: Ensure UI components meet accessibility standards and layout adapts correctly on different screen sizes and devices.

steps.description: Use accessibility tools to check UI contrast, ARIA labels, and keyboard navigation across the app
Resize browser window or access app on various devices (mobile, tablet, desktop)
UI remains usable, readable and responsive with no broken elements or inaccessible controls
